title: Priya Parker on conflict and connection
text: I found this discussion with Priya Parker to be illuminating. She is a conflict resolution expert who has interesting ideas about our current extreme views on individualism / space/ privacy and a different value on collectivism and gathering and interactions.  Her take on multiculturalism, the failings on both the West and the East is stimulating.  She offers some specific ideas in referencing her book on the Art of Gathering.
